title: Architecture Board Charter
summary: Charter establishing the Architecture Board as the governing body for all technical and architectural decisions within Bhavya Foundation.

sections.heading: Authority
sections.body: The Architecture Board has authority to approve, reject, or supersede all Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), technical standards, and capability contracts.

sections.heading: Membership
sections.body: Board members are appointed by the Trustees and include representatives from Engineering, Governance, and Release domains.
